source_text: Well, I don't understand why this would be failing now.  How many months have we been working on this machine?  Many.  And the concept of an "outer cascade" that selects from these tasks has certainly been discussed, and I think implemented.  Meanwhile, when I told you to run the WM in a debugger and repair things live, you just passed right past the most important thing and prepared to record an "abstention" as if that was a valid status.  It isn't.  The machine is in my view broken and your job is to repair it so that it works, I don't see how there is anything unclear or ambiguous about this instruction.  If you have any questions for me you should ask them now.
